name: inclusivehar
paper_title: InclusiveHAR: A Smartphone-Based Dataset for Human Activity Recognition Across Diverse Physical Abilities
authors: Seyed Reza Kamel Tabbakh Farizani, Iman Naeimi, Kosar Naghavi, Fatemeh Majidi Nasab, Mehran Ghaffarian, Mahdieh Sadat Sharifi Moghaddam Kakhki
notes: Dataset only; no Data-in-Brief or companion journal paper found (verified via WebSearch). 20 participants (10 non-disabled, 10 with disabilities). Data recorded with an iPhone 14 Pro worn vertically in a waist pouch. Sensors: accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, motion sensors, GPS-derived data. Sampling rate 50 Hz. Six activities: walking, standing, sitting, jogging, ramp ascent, ramp descent. For wheelchair users, 'walking' labels denote manual propulsion. CSV time-series table: 30 feature columns + activity label + binary 'disabled' indicator (0=non-disabled, 1=disabled) + UserID. Version 4 published 2026-02-18. Landing page saved as webpage.html (Mendeley is a JS SPA; default <title> is 'FAQ' but embedded metadata incl. DOI/authors/license/description is present in the HTML).
